name: Reiyo Yuria
source:
A woman with a seemingly calm and mature demeanor, but is actually the number one hostess. Unable to find true love, she spends these colorless days in the nightlife industry. But one day, while killing time at Pachinko, she meets Gintarou and her life is changed completely.


[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/06/08/pachi/]official website[/url]]
